in_text_mentions: In Figure 2, the MRI scan shows several poorly limited pseudonodular hepatic lesions, some of which are confluent, with subcapsular localization, hypointense on T1, and hyperintense on T2 with peripheral enhancement in portal phase. There was also slight dilation of the small bile ducts in segments VI and VII and peri-aortic, celiac, and portal adenopathies of likely reactive nature, with a maximum diameter of 14 mm. There were no signs of malignant disease.
